faults.title: Clunking rear dampers (early Mk2)
faults.description: Some early 2014-on Mk2 Aygos had clunking rear shock absorbers. Auto Express says new ones should have been fitted under warranty.

faults.title: Tailgate lock misalignment (Mk2)
faults.description: The tailgate lock can go out of line so the boot won't open. Adjusting it is all that's needed.

faults.title: Steering column recall (Mk2)
faults.description: Mk2 cars built in September and October 2014 were recalled in June 2016 over steering column failure that could cause loss of control.

faults.title: Water leaks into the boot (Mk1)
faults.description: Carbuyer says the main weak spot on the 2005-2014 Mk1 is water getting in around the rear window and lights. Check the boot area for damp.

faults.title: Coolant leaks, rusty exhaust and clutch wear (Mk1)
faults.description: Carbuyer also flags Mk1 water pumps leaking coolant, rear brake cylinders weeping fluid, exhaust back boxes rusting through early, clutch problems and catalytic converter failures.
